title: Rafram bar Pappa (II)
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman places him younger than Rava, as in [Berakhot 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.50a.16): Rafram bar Pappa came to the synagogue of Avi Gibar; he rose, read from the scroll and said “Bless.” Rava said to him: “Black pot, why get involved in a dispute? Besides, people follow Rabbi Yishmael’s practice.” [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Berakhot.50a.16.1) explains “pot” as an earthenware vessel. Hyman contrasts his commentary on [Avodah Zarah 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Avodah_Zarah.16b.11.3), taking this Rafram to have been like a student of Rava. Hyman considers it in no way possible to say that this is Rafram bar Pappa, the great student of Rav Chisda, who knew Rav Chisda, for how could Rava speak of him in such language?

This Rafram bar Pappa merited to sit on the seat of Pumbedita after Rav Dimi of Nehardea, from the year 696 until the year 706, as cited in the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon, end of chapter 3 — except that there it reads simply Rafram; but in the Ra’avad’s Sefer HaKabbalah it reads Rafram bar Pappa; Hyman considers the dates there a scribal error, writing that he headed the academy in 696 and died in 696; he proposes 706. This Rafram is mentioned in [Ketubot 86a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.86a.5) and [Bava Kamma 98b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.98b.5), where they said: “There was a case, and Rafram [bar Pappa] compelled Rav Ashi and collected from him like a beam for an image,” and Rashi explains: he compelled Rav Ashi, who had burned his fellow’s document in his youth, for in fact Rav Ashi lived many years afterward, dying in 738.[^3]

notes.text: Saved Davidson Berakhot50a fully writes Rabbi Yishmael, removing the former title hedge for ר״י. Hyman’s impossibility claim and student identification remain his; dates696/706/738 are retained without era conversion. The beam/image expression is a valuation metaphor, not a transfer of an actual beam.

Berakhot 50a directly names Rafram bar Pappa, Rava and Rabbi Yishmael. Hyman’s impossibility of identifying him with Chisda’s student, comparison of Rashi’s glosses, academy succession and correction of the Sefer HaKabbalah date remain his arguments. Dates 696,706 and 738 have no added era conversion.

Both legal passages name Rafram without the patronymic. [Rashi on Bava Kamma](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Bava_Kamma.98b.5.3) explains that Rav Ashi had burned another person’s document in his youth. The [consulted Epistle](https://www.sefaria.org/Epistle_of_Rav_Sherira_Gaon.1.103) gives 696 for Zevid’s death, 699 for Dimi’s and 706 for Rafram’s, with no era added here. Heilprin’s notices for [Rafram bar Pappa](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3252&lang=en) and [Rafram II](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3253&lang=en) distinguish a teaching dossier and an academy notice. Hyman’s proposed separation and his correction of Sefer HaKabbalah remain his arguments.
